Why Strength Matters

3 in 4 Australians Don't Meet National Strength Training Guidelines

(Australian Bureau of Statistics, 2022) — The guidelines, in place since 2014, recommend at least 2 sessions per week targeting major muscle groups.

Inactivity & Weight
2 in 3

Australian adults are overweight or obese. Muscle tissue is metabolically active — building it raises your resting metabolism and improves how your body manages energy and blood sugar.

Bone Health
2 in 3

People aged 50+ have osteopenia or osteoporosis. Resistance training is one of the most effective ways to maintain and build bone density — reducing fracture risk as you age.

Strength Loss
1–3%
/ year

Average muscle strength decline from age 40 — accelerating after 60. This affects mobility, balance, injury risk, and independence. Consistent training stops it in its tracks.

About

Anthony

Cert III Fitness Cert IV Fitness Henselmans CPT Anytime Fitness Enoggera

I'm a certified personal trainer based at Anytime Fitness Enoggera. My approach is evidence-based and built entirely around you — whether you've never set foot in a gym or you're chasing a new personal best, it's my passion to help people build strength, improve health, and to actually enjoy the process.

I'm always looking to further my training knowledge, and that's why I chose to complete the Henselmans CPT — one of the most rigorous evidence-based PT qualifications available. I use it to design programs grounded in physiology, not guesswork — and I'm always happy to explain the reasoning behind every choice.

What I Do

More Than Just a Session

Every program covers the full picture — not just what happens in the gym.

Personalised Program Design
Built around your goals, training history, and schedule — with structured progressions so you keep moving forward week after week.
Nutrition Guidance
Full practical and sustainable advice on calories, macros, and micronutrients — tailored to your lifestyle, not a rigid plan you'll abandon after a week.
Recovery Guidance
Sleep, stress, and recovery all shape your results. I help you build habits around the full picture, not just training days.
Progressive Overload & Tracking
I track your numbers and adjust loads and rep ranges over time so the challenge stays dialled in as you get stronger.
Accountability & Check-ins
Regular reviews to assess progress, answer questions, and keep things on track. You always know where you stand and what's next.
